questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers share the same relationship as that shared by the numbers in the given set.

(6, 8, 192)
questions.solution:
The Logic here is as follows:

**(1st Number × 2ⁿd number) × 4 = 3rd Number**

**In **(6, 8, 192)

**(1st Number × 2ⁿd number) × 4**

= (6 × 8) × 4

= 48 × 4

= 192 **= 3rd Number**

Now check the all options,

**Option (1) **(12, 13, 263)

**(1st Number × 2ⁿd number) × 4**

= (12 × 13) × 4

= 156 × 4

= 624 ≠** 3rd Number**

**Option (2) **(8, 11, 180)

**(1st Number × 2ⁿd number) × 4**

= (8 × 11) × 4

= 88 × 4

= 352 ≠** 3rd Number**

**Option (3) **(11, 9, 396)

**(1st Number × 2ⁿd number) × 4**

**= ****(11× 9) × 4**

**= 99 × 4**

**= 396** =** 3rd Number**

**Option (4) **(7, 5, 78)

**(1st Number × 2ⁿd number) × 4**

= (7 × 5) × 4

= 35 × 4

= 140 ≠** 3rd Number**

Hence, the correct answer is **"****(11, 9, 396)".**

questions.question: Ankit is 30 years younger than his father. After 4 years Ankit's sister will be half the age of her father. The total of the present ages of Ankit and his sister is 67 years. What is the present age of Ankit's father?
questions.solution:
**Let,**

Ankit present age = a years

Ankit’s father present age = b years

Ankit’s sister present age = c years

**Given:**

**1)** Ankit is 30 years younger than his father.

=> a = b – 30 → **Eq. (1)**

**2)** After 4 years Ankit's sister will be half the age of her father.

=> c + 4 = (b + 4) / 2

=> (c + 4) × 2 = b + 4

questions.question:
Which two signs and two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

12 × 5 + 7 ÷ 4 – 6 = 25
questions.solution:
According to the BODMAS rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

**Option 1 :** × and +, 12 and 4

Given:

12 × 5 + 7 ÷ 4 – 6 = 25

After interchange the signs;

4 + 5 × 7 ÷ 12 – 6 = 25

By BODMAS rule

4 + 5 × 0.584 – 6 = 25

4 + 2.92 – 6 = 25

6.92 – 6 = 25

0.92 = 25** (LHS ≠ RHS)**

**Option 2 : **× and ÷, 7 and 6

**Given:**

12 × 5 + 7 ÷ 4 – 6 = 25

After interchange the signs;

12 ÷ 5 + 6 × 4 – 7 = 25

By BODMAS rule

2.4 + 6 × 4 – 7 = 25

2.4 + 24 – 7 = 25

26.4 – 7 = 25

19.4 = 25** (LHS ≠ RHS)**

**Option 3 :** × and −, 6 and 5

Given:

12 × 5 + 7 ÷ 4 – 6 = 25

After interchange the signs;

12 - 5 + 7 ÷ 4 × 6 = 25

By BODMAS rule

12 - 6 + 1.75 × 5 = 25

12 - 6 + 8.75 = 25

20.75 - 6 = 25

14.75 = 25** (LHS ≠ RHS)**

**Option 4 :** ÷ and −, 4 and 12

**Given:**

**12 × 5 + 7 ÷ 4 – 6 = 25**

**After interchange the signs;**

**4 × 5 + 7 - 12 ÷ 6 = 25**

**By BODMAS rule**

**4 × 5 + 7 - 2 = 25**

**20 + 7 - 2 = 25**

**27 - 2 = 25**

**25 = 25 (LHS = RHS)**

Hence, the answer is **“****÷ and −, 4 and 12****”.**

questions.solution:
The opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below method:-

 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surfaces are touched by side or by corners

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.

Below are the opposite surfaces:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ac99cdfb6083376368c0c4697870a6553d269b4aacf69b0541f7fcc280d16f9.png] 

 
 

 
 
**Alphabets**

 
 
 
**Opposite alphabets**

 
 
 

 
 
m

 
 
 
o

 
 
 

 
 
a

 
 
 
c

 
 
 

 
 
d

 
 
 
e

 
 
 

 

**Note:- Two opposite faces are never seen together or adjacent to each other.**

**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34e0783a85b424a1647b81e2129dceb26a888fe0f43e9d9dde176eff8ce5508d.png] 

**In figure (A): None of the opposite faces are seen together nor they are adjacent to each other. Thus this cube can be made.**

**In figure (B):** **‘o’** and **‘m’** are opposite faces but here they are seen together which is wrong. Thus this cube cannot be made.

**In figure (C):** **‘a’** and **‘c’** are opposite faces but here they are seen together which is wrong. Thus this cube cannot be made.

**In figure (D):** **None of the opposite faces are seen together nor they are adjacent to each other. Thus this cube can be made.**

Hence, **‘Only A and D’** is the correct answer

p _ q q r _ p p q _ r r _ p q _ _ r

options.text: r p q r p q
q p r q r q
q q p p r r
p r q p q r

questions.solution:
Given :- p _ q q r _ p p q _ r r _ p q _ _ r

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

**Option (1) **r p q r p q → p **__r__** q q r **__p__** **-** p p q **__q__** r r **-** **__r__** p q **__p__** **__q__** r

**Option (2)** q p r q r q → p **__q__** q q r **__p__** **-** p p q **__r__** r r **-** **__q__** p q **__r__** **__q__** r

**Option (3) **q q p p r r → p **__q__** q q r **__q__** **-** p p q **__p__** r r **-** **__p__** p q **__r__** **__r__** r

**Option (4) p r q p q r → **p __p__ q q r __r__ - p p q __q__ r r - __p__ p q __q__ __r__ r
